root_cause.text: The error handling in `ipcomp_post_acomp()` jumps to the `out_free_req` label, which was positioned after the loop that frees destination scatterlist pages, causing a memory leak of those pages when a compression error occurs.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the `out_free_req` label before the page-freeing loop, ensuring that the loop (`for (; dsg && sg_page(dsg); dsg = sg_next(dsg)) __free_page(sg_page(dsg));`) is executed on error paths as well as success, as shown in the diff and described in the CVE: "Move the out_free_req label up by a couple of lines so that the allocated dst SG list gets freed on error as well as success."
